title: 横断旗の旗立て
description: 通学路の横断歩道脇に置く、横断旗を入れる黄色い箱と支柱です。表面設置の支柱とベース、取付バンド、前が低い旗入れ箱、竹の柄の無地の黄色い旗4本を造形しています。旗は文字のない無地で、布のなびきや揺れは静的な形状です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.576 × 1.441 × 0.255 m、2,936三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A yellow crossing-flag box on a post beside a school-route crosswalk. It models the surface-mounted post and base plate, clamp bands, a flag box with a lower front, and four plain yellow flags on bamboo sticks. The flags carry no lettering, and the cloth is static geometry without wind motion. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.576 × 1.441 × 0.255 m; 2,936 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
